pet_notes: A compact whole-body plush maker spirit with an ivory face, charcoal body, large attentive dark eyes, a soft teal knit cap, and a small coral thread loop secured at the cap side. Warm, capable, curious, thoughtful, lightly playful. Simple connected silhouette, no handheld prop, no readable text or logos.
style_notes: Polished handcrafted plush mascot, tactile felt and knit textures, restrained palette of charcoal, ivory, teal, and coral, crisp silhouette and expressive pose language.
